source.title: 20 MIN FULL BODY WORKOUT - Intense Version / No Equipment I Pamela Reif

notes: Checked against the video, every 15 s. Thirty-second moves back to back from 16 s, one 1 min rest (616-676 s). The name is in the box under a small NXT box that announces the next move (the draft read the NXT, one move early); a timer ring top right counts 30 to 0 per move. A left/right move is two steps. No sections.
